**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.** No blockers. One note on the body text is below. Please correct it before the merge.

Reviewed head: `b852d725732a0d5d955ebbd3e62ed8bea38c4072`. Trial merge with `upstream/main` at `b2afd64ed3a3cd465c57aefbd4b80938bd6cd8c6`: clean, no conflicts. The parents #4218 and #4220 are merged. Thus the net diff against `main` is only the 2D / 3D slice (12 files, +266 / -69).

Ownership record of this review: https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/4221#issuecomment-7225050686

### Scope and tier

- The diff changes only `crates/ui` and one decision record. It does not change posted G-code, gouge or collision checks, stock simulation or geometry. This is not a safety-tier review.
- No process file, no `build.rs`, no `scripts/`, no `.github/`, no dependency. No snapshot PNG.
- No file under `testdata/`, no importer code. The extra suites of the importer and test-data rules do not apply.

### What looks good

- Each new helper in `layout/controls.rs` draws exactly what the raw call drew: `button_enabled`, `small_button_enabled`, `checkbox`, `list_row_truncated`, `note`. I compared each call site line by line.
- `drag_row` / `drag_sized_row` register the field in the ring and set `labelled_by`. This is the same as the old `ring` + `row_label_id` code in `fields::int_range_row`, which now calls `drag_row`. No behaviour change there.
- The guard now joins a line that starts with `.` to the line before it. This closes a real hole: the old line count did not see the split `ui` / `.add_enabled(` call in `deburr_page.rs`. The new test `the_guard_counts_a_raw_call_split_over_two_lines` pins it.
- The new helper test checks clicks on disabled buttons, the check box toggle, the text of the note and of the cut row, and the SpinButton names.
- No `unwrap`, `expect` or `panic!` in non-test code. No UI state is written outside the existing paths. The edits stay inside the existing param structs, which the page Apply flow commits as before.
- Provenance lines are kept. All touched files are under 400 lines (`form_seam_tests.rs` is 380).
- The body has before/after screenshots of the Wire Contour page, linked from the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch. It has a `Changelog:` line and `Refs #1122` (partial work). The commit subjects are conventional.

### Results (locally, on host egg, trial merge with main)

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | 10 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled (2.1 min) |
| ui build (`--no-run`) | ok |
| ui suites: lib | ok, 1772 passed, 0 failed, 8 ignored (software GPU adapter llvmpipe) |
| ui suites: boundary, boundary_picks, contour_dxf_sketch, sinker_setup, tap_hand, theme_example, theme_files, waterjet_tool | ok, all pass |
| `cargo clippy --no-deps --all-targets -p camcraft-ui -- -D warnings` | clean |

Extra suites run: none apply. The diff has no `testdata/` change and no importer change. The diff does not touch posts, operations, motion or the catalog, so `example_catalog` is not required.

### Mutations (run by this review)

1. `wire_page.rs`: Tab count back to a raw call, split as `ui` / `.add(DragValue::new(count))`. Result: `pages_do_not_add_raw_egui_calls_outside_the_form_seam` goes RED. The split-line join works on real page source.
2. `layout/controls.rs` `seam_field`: the row label is removed (`match None::<egui::Id>`). Result: `the_2d_seam_helpers_keep_clicks_text_and_names` goes RED. `form_seam_controls_preserve_labels_clicks_and_accessible_names` also goes RED, because `int_range_row` now uses `drag_row`.

I restored the tree after the mutations. The pinning tests bite.

### Heavy and light lanes

- `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main --dry-run`: the diff reaches no heavy lane (0 steps).
- Light lane: not run. Its six twins are in `motion` and `app`. This diff changes only `crates/ui`, which those twins do not build. Per AGENTS.md "Heavy lanes at review", a light result is a note and not a merge condition.

### Note (not blocking): the EDM condition field does not join the Tab ring

The body, the `Changelog:` line and `docs/decisions/1122-form-seam-2d.md:31-34` say that seven fields "join the Tab / Enter field order and have an accessible name". The list includes "EDM condition".

- `sinker_page.rs:108` now draws EDM condition with `layout::text_row`.
- `text_row` (`layout/form.rs:90-98`) sets `labelled_by`. It does not call `field_ring::register`.
- Thus EDM condition gets its accessible name, but it is not in the Tab / Enter ring. Only the six `DragValue` fields join the ring.

Please do one of these before the merge:

- Change the `Changelog:` line and the decision record. Say that six number fields join the ring, and that the EDM condition field gets its accessible name only.
- Or register the text field in the ring, with a pinning test. This is new code and needs a new review.

The first option is a body and docs edit only. The code is correct as it is.

### Follow-ups (file after merge)

- None.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
